scope: Local PostgreSQL verification; not hosted evidence

checks: Snapshot 1: all tables/views match; repeated import has no duplicates
Snapshot 2: all tables/views match; repeated import has no duplicates
Overlapping IDs in two retained snapshots do not collide or cross-join
Parity failure rolls back publication and preserves previous latest
Anonymous reads exclude drafts through tables and views; writes are denied
report.scope: Local Postgres; hosted storage and deployment require separate checks
Logical rows, compressed artifact bytes and frozen query identity; restoration, HTTP routes and recovery timings are separate operator steps.

report.database_restore: pg_dump custom archive followed by pg_restore --exit-on-error into separate research_restore_test database

limitations: Isolated relational-volume fixture; synthetic scopes omit duplicate downloads and query workloads.
Single EXPLAIN ANALYZE per read, after ANALYZE; not a cold-cache, concurrent or hosted latency measurement.
No production publication or existing database is modified; dedicated test database is retained for inspection.
